problem.explanation: DISTINCT removes duplicate projected city values, then ORDER BY gives stable alphabetical output. A common mistake is including customer name too, which makes otherwise repeated cities distinct. GROUP BY city can produce the same set when no aggregate is needed.
hints: Several customers may share the same city.
Use DISTINCT on the projected city column before ordering.
problem.reference_solution: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers ORDER BY city
problem.statement_markdown: Return the unique cities represented by customers. Sort city names alphabetically.
problem.title: Distinct customer cities
